entities.summary: Tam Nsaliwa (b. 1982-01-28, Lilongwe) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lilongwe and Canada. Known in the fields of canada, composers & musicians, americas.
